title: The Ledger of Greywater Bay
author: Noor Sandoval
blurb: Bram Crane, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
